def _docs_version(value: str, policy: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:-([^+]+))?(?:\+.+)?", value)
    if match is None:
        raise EvidenceError(f"invalid Cargo package version: {value!r}")
    return (int(match.group(1)) > 0 or policy.get("allow_unstable", False)) and (
        match.group(4) is None or policy.get("allow_prerelease", True)
    )


def _table(value: object, name: str, keys: set[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise EvidenceError(f"invalid testing policy: {name} must be a table")
    unknown = sorted(set(value) - keys)
    if unknown:
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"invalid testing policy: unknown {name} keys {', '.join(unknown)}"
        )
    return value


def _entries(table: dict[str, Any], key: str, name: str) -> list[Any]:
    value = table.get(key, [])
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"invalid testing policy: {name} must be an array of tables"
        )
    return value


def _boolean(table: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> bool:
    value = table.get(key, False)
    if not isinstance(value, bool):
        raise EvidenceError(f"invalid testing policy: {key} must be a boolean")
    return value


def _strings(
    table: dict[str, Any], key: str, default: tuple[str, ...]
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    value = table.get(key, list(default))
    if not isinstance(value, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in value):
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"invalid testing policy: {key} must be an array of strings"
        )
    return tuple(value)


def _categories(table: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    categories = _strings(table, "categories", ())
    if any(category not in CATEGORIES for category in categories):
        raise EvidenceError("invalid testing policy: unknown test category")
    return categories


def _rust_selection(table: dict[str, Any], host_only: bool) -> RustSelection:
    selection = RustSelection(
        all_features=_boolean(table, "all_features"),
        no_default_features=_boolean(table, "no_default_features"),
        features=_strings(table, "features", ()),
        packages=_strings(table, "packages", ()),
        exclude=_strings(table, "exclude", ()),
        coverage_host_only=host_only,
    )
    if (selection.packages and selection.exclude) or any(
        not name.strip() for name in (*selection.packages, *selection.exclude)
    ):
        raise EvidenceError(
            "Rust testing selects packages or excludes workspace packages, never both"
        )
    return selection


def _filter(table: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
    value = table.get("filter")
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip() or value.startswith("-"):
        raise EvidenceError(
            "invalid testing policy: filter must be a nonempty expression, not an option"
        )
    return value


def _install(table: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    value = table.get("install", INSTALLS[0])
    if value not in INSTALLS:
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"invalid testing policy: install must be one of {', '.join(INSTALLS)}"
        )
    return value


def _scripts(testing: dict[str, Any], language: str) -> tuple[Configuration, ...]:
    """One runner per category; each category is its own `default` configuration."""
    name = f"testing.{language}"
    table = _table(testing.get(language, {}), name, set(CATEGORIES))
    configurations = []
    for category in CATEGORIES:
        if category not in table:
            continue
        entry = _table(table[category], f"{name}.{category}", SCRIPT_KEYS)
        command = _strings(entry, "command", ())
        directory = entry.get("directory", ".")
        timeout = entry.get("timeout_seconds")
        if (
            not command
            or not command[0].strip()
            or not any(JUNIT_PLACEHOLDER in argument for argument in command)
            or not isinstance(directory, str)
            or (timeout is not None and not _positive(timeout))
        ):
            raise EvidenceError(
                f"{name}.{category} requires a command writing JUnit to "
                f"{JUNIT_PLACEHOLDER}, a relative directory, and a positive timeout"
            )
        _relative(
            directory, f"{name}.{category} directory must stay within the project"
        )
        runner = ScriptRunner(directory, command, timeout)
        configurations.append(Configuration("default", (category,), runner))
    return tuple(configurations)


def _name(table: dict[str, Any], names: set[str]) -> str:
    name = table.get("name")
    if (
        not isinstance(name, str)
        or not name
        or not all(c.isascii() and (c.isalnum() or c in "-_") for c in name)
        or name == "default"
        or name != name.lower()
        or name in RESERVED_NAMES
        or _device(name)
        or name in names
    ):
        raise EvidenceError(
            "test configuration names must be unique portable names other than default"
        )
    names.add(name)
    return name


def _native_profile(profile: object) -> str | None:
    if profile is None:
        return None
    name = profile.lower() if isinstance(profile, str) else ""
    if (
        not isinstance(profile, str)
        or not profile
        or profile.startswith("-")
        or not all(c.isascii() and (c.isalnum() or c in "-_") for c in profile)
        or name in RESERVED_PROFILES
        or name.startswith("cargo")
        or _device(name)
    ):
        raise EvidenceError(
            "testing.python.native_profile must be a nonempty portable Cargo profile name"
        )
    return profile


def _device(name: str) -> bool:
    return len(name) == 4 and name[:3] in ("com", "lpt") and name[3] in "123456789"


def _relative(path: str, message: str) -> None:
    candidate = Path(path)
    if (
        not path
        or candidate.is_absolute()
        or path.startswith(("/", "\\"))
        or ".." in candidate.parts
    ):
        raise EvidenceError(message)


def _positive(value: object) -> bool:
    return (
        isinstance(value, int)
        and not isinstance(value, bool)
        and 0 < value <= 2**64 // 5
    )


def _period(seconds: int) -> str:
    return "{period='" + str(seconds) + "s',terminate-after=1}"


def _parse(text: str) -> ElementTree.Element:
    # Coverage.py emits a DOCTYPE; expat never fetches external entities.
    try:
        return ElementTree.fromstring(text)
    except ElementTree.ParseError as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"invalid validation XML: {error}") from error


def _document(root: ElementTree.Element) -> str:
    body = ElementTree.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    return f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n{body}\n'


def _testcases(root: ElementTree.Element) -> Iterator[ElementTree.Element]:
    return root.iter("testcase")


def _child(node: ElementTree.Element, tag: str) -> bool:
    return node.find(tag) is not None


def _slow(category: str, seconds: float, instrumented: bool) -> bool:
    limit = SLOW_MILLISECONDS.get(category)
    return not instrumented and limit is not None and seconds * 1000.0 > limit


def _qualify(node: ElementTree.Element, attribute: str, configuration: str) -> None:
    existing = node.get(attribute)
    node.set(
        attribute, configuration if existing is None else f"{configuration}/{existing}"
    )


def _milliseconds(seconds: float) -> int:
    return int(seconds * 1000.0 + 0.5)


def _tests_csv(suites: Sequence[Suite]) -> str:
    lines = [TESTS_HEADER]
    for suite in suites:
        deadline = "" if suite.deadline_ms is None else str(suite.deadline_ms)
        for case in suite.cases:
            lines.append(
                ",".join(
                    [
                        suite.category,
                        suite.language,
                        csv_field(case.package),
                        csv_field(case.name),
                        case.outcome,
                        str(_milliseconds(case.seconds)),
                        deadline,
                        "true" if case.slow else "false",
                    ]
                )
            )
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def _tests_markdown(
    suites: Sequence[Suite],
    coverage: Sequence[tuple[str, int, int, str | None]],
    limits: tuple[tuple[str, int], ...] = Policy().limits,
) -> str:
    text = (
        "# Test Results\n\nLatest run of each category and language. Every case is in "
        "`tests.csv`; native JUnit is in `tests-<category>-<language>.xml`.\n"
    )
    if not suites:
        text += "\nNo test reports are retained.\n"
    for suite in suites:
        counts = {outcome: 0 for outcome in OUTCOMES}
        for case in suite.cases:
            counts[case.outcome] += 1
        slow = sum(case.slow for case in suite.cases)
        text += (
            f"\n## {title(suite.category)} {title(suite.language)}\n\n"
            f"Revision `{suite.revision or 'unknown'}`: {len(suite.cases)} tests, "
            f"{counts['passed']} passed, {counts['failed']} failed, {counts['skipped']} "
            f"skipped, {slow} slow."
        )
        limit = dict(limits)[suite.category]
        scope = "project"
        text += f" Authored test limit: {limit} across all files and languages in the {scope}; executed cases may expand parameterized tests."
        grouped: dict[str, int] = {}
        for case in suite.cases:
            grouped[case.package] = grouped.get(case.package, 0) + 1
        text += (
            "\n\n| Target | Executed Tests | Authored Limit |\n| --- | ---: | ---: |\n"
        )
        if suite.category in ("acceptance", "system"):
            text += f"| Repository | {len(suite.cases)} | {limit} |\n"
        else:
            for package, count in sorted(grouped.items()):
                text += f"| {markdown_cell(package)} | {count} | {limit} |\n"
        if suite.deadline_ms is not None:
            text += f" Deadline {suite.deadline_ms} ms per test."
        text += (
            "\n\n| Outcome | Package | Test | Duration (ms) | Slow |\n"
            "| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- |\n"
        )
        for case in suite.cases:
            cells = [
                case.outcome,
                markdown_cell(case.package),
                markdown_cell(case.name),
                str(_milliseconds(case.seconds)),
                "yes" if case.slow else "",
            ]
            text += "| " + " | ".join(cells) + " |\n"
    if coverage:
        text += (
            "\n## Coverage\n\n| Language | Source Run | Lines Covered | Lines Valid | Line Rate |\n"
            "| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n"
        )
        for language, covered, valid, source in coverage:
            text += (
                f"| {language} | {source or 'unknown'} | {covered} | {valid} | "
                f"{rate(covered, valid) * 100.0:.1f}% |\n"
            )
    return text


def _nanoseconds(seconds: object) -> float | None:
    return seconds * 1e9 if isinstance(seconds, int | float) else None


def _change(row: Row) -> float | None:
    previous = row.previous_median_ns
    if previous is None or previous <= 0.0:
        return None
    return (row.median_ns - previous) / previous * 100.0


def _optional(value: int | None) -> str:
    return "" if value is None else str(value)


def _optional_float(value: float | None) -> str:
    return "" if value is None else f"{value:.1f}"


def _duration(nanoseconds: float) -> str:
    if nanoseconds >= 1e9:
        return f"{nanoseconds / 1e9:.3f} s"
    if nanoseconds >= 1e6:
        return f"{nanoseconds / 1e6:.3f} ms"
    if nanoseconds >= 1e3:
        return f"{nanoseconds / 1e3:.3f} µs"
    return f"{nanoseconds:.1f} ns"


def _optional_duration(value: float | None) -> str:
    return "" if value is None else _duration(value)


def _float(text: str) -> float | None:
    try:
        return float(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _int(text: str) -> int | None:
    try:
        return int(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _split(line: str) -> list[str]:
    """Split one CSV line written by `csv_field`, honoring doubled quotes."""
    fields = [""]
    quoted = False
    index = 0
    while index < len(line):
        character = line[index]
        if character == '"' and quoted and line[index + 1 : index + 2] == '"':
            fields[-1] += '"'
            index += 1
        elif character == '"':
            quoted = not quoted
        elif character == "," and not quoted:
            fields.append("")
        else:
            fields[-1] += character
        index += 1
    return fields


def _attempt(action: Any) -> Any:
    """Run one step, returning its error instead of raising so evidence still publishes."""
    try:
        return action()
    except EvidenceError as error:
        return error
    except OSError as error:
        return EvidenceError(
            f"{error.strerror or error}: {error.filename or ''}".rstrip(": ")
        )


def _message(error: object) -> str | None:
    return str(error) if isinstance(error, EvidenceError) else None


def _platform() -> str:
    return {"win32": "windows", "darwin": "macos"}.get(sys.platform, sys.platform)


def _architecture() -> str:
    machine = platform.machine().lower()
    return {"amd64": "x86_64", "arm64": "aarch64"}.get(machine, machine)


def _project_root(start: Path) -> Path:
    for path in (start, *start.parents):
        if (path / "tools/python/evidence.toml").is_file():
            return path
    return start


def _config(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = root / "tools/python/evidence.toml"
    try:
        document = (
            tomllib.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.is_file() else {}
        )
        if "limits" in document.get("testing", {}):
            raise EvidenceError(
                "tools/python/evidence.toml: testing.limits belongs in stkr.toml [conventions.testing.limits]"
            )
        authored = root / "stkr.toml"
        if authored.is_file():
            conventions = tomllib.loads(authored.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get(
                "conventions", {}
            )
            limits = conventions.get("testing", {}).get("limits")
            if limits is not None:
                document.setdefault("testing", {})["limits"] = limits
        return document
    except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"invalid test configuration: {error}") from error


def _real_directories(root: Path, relative: str, message: str) -> Path:
    """Create each component, refusing symlinked or non-directory components."""
    directory = root
    for part in Path(relative).parts:
        directory = directory / part
        if directory.is_symlink() or (directory.exists() and not directory.is_dir()):
            raise EvidenceError(message)
        directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        if directory.is_symlink() or not directory.is_dir():
            raise EvidenceError(message)
    return directory


def _state(root: Path) -> Path:
    message = "private state must be a real directory"
    state = _real_directories(root, STATE, message)
    _real_directories(root, f"{STATE}/logs", message)
    return state


def _directory(root: Path, benchmark: bool = False) -> Path:
    return _real_directories(
        root,
        BENCHMARKS if benchmark else VALIDATION,
        "validation evidence directory must be a real directory, not a symlink",
    )


def _publish(root: Path, name: str, text: str, benchmark: bool = False) -> None:
    """Atomically replace one flat evidence file through its `.tmp` sibling."""
    directory = _directory(root, benchmark)
    target = directory / name
    if target.is_symlink() or (target.exists() and not target.is_file()):
        raise EvidenceError(f"validation evidence {name} must be a regular file")
    temporary = directory / f"{name}.tmp"
    if temporary.is_symlink() or (temporary.exists() and not temporary.is_file()):
        raise EvidenceError("temporary validation evidence must be a regular file")
    # An interrupted publication can leave this single bounded temporary file.
    temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    try:
        with temporary.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as file:
            file.write(text)
        os.replace(temporary, target)
    except OSError:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise


def _retract(root: Path, name: str, benchmark: bool = False) -> None:
    """Remove a flat evidence file whose run produced no fresh replacement."""
    path = root / (BENCHMARKS if benchmark else VALIDATION) / name
    if path.is_symlink() or path.is_file():
        path.unlink()
    elif path.exists():
        raise EvidenceError(f"validation evidence {name} must be a regular file")


def _flat(root: Path, name: str, text: str | None) -> None:
    if text is None:
        _retract(root, name)
    else:
        _publish(root, name, text)


def _manifest(root: Path, benchmark: bool = False) -> Record | None:
    """The current run manifest; an unreadable manifest is replaced, never trusted."""
    path = root / (BENCHMARKS if benchmark else VALIDATION) / "latest.json"
    if path.is_symlink() or (path.exists() and not path.is_file()):
        raise EvidenceError("validation evidence must be a regular file")
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    try:
        value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return None
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None


def _clear_tests(root: Path, policy: Policy, key: str, language: str) -> None:
    """Clear this run and retired categories while holding publication ownership."""
    manifest = _manifest(root) or {"schema_version": 1}
    manifest["host"] = {"os": _platform(), "arch": _architecture()}
    tests = manifest.get("tests", {})
    tests = tests if isinstance(tests, dict) else {}
    document = _config(root).get("testing", {})
    configured = {
        f"{category}-{candidate}"
        for candidate in LANGUAGES
        if candidate in document
        for category in CATEGORIES
        if (category != "unit" or dict(policy.limits)["unit"] > 0)
        if any(
            category
            in (
                selection.categories
                or tuple(
                    category
                    for category in ("unit", "integration")
                    if category != "unit" or dict(policy.limits)["unit"] > 0
                )
            )
            for selection in getattr(policy, candidate)
        )
    }
    configured.add(key)
    for candidate in LANGUAGES:
        for category in CATEGORIES:
            retained = f"{category}-{candidate}"
            if retained not in configured:
                _retract(root, f"tests-{retained}.xml")
    for retained in list(tests):
        if retained == key or retained not in configured:
            tests.pop(retained)
            _retract(root, f"tests-{retained}.xml")
    _retract(root, f"tests-{key}.xml")
    coverage = manifest.get("coverage", {})
    coverage = coverage if isinstance(coverage, dict) else {}
    for candidate, owner in list(coverage.items()):
        if candidate == language or f"{owner}-{candidate}" not in configured:
            coverage.pop(candidate)
            _retract(root, f"coverage-{candidate}.xml")
    manifest["tests"] = tests
    manifest["coverage"] = coverage
    _publish(root, "latest.json", json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))
    _publish_tests(root)


def _update(root: Path, section: str, key: str, value: object) -> None:
    """Replace one runner-owned entry of the run manifest, preserving every other field."""
    benchmark = section == "benchmarks"
    manifest = _manifest(root, benchmark) or {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "host": {"os": _platform(), "arch": _architecture()},
    }
    if not isinstance(manifest.get(section), dict):
        manifest[section] = {}
    manifest[section][key] = value
    _publish(root, "latest.json", json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), benchmark)


def _publish_tests(root: Path) -> None:
    """Regenerate `tests.csv` and `tests.md` from every retained flat report."""
    directory = _directory(root)
    manifest = _manifest(root) or {}
    reports = [
        (category, language, path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for category in CATEGORIES
        for language in LANGUAGES
        if (path := directory / f"tests-{category}-{language}.xml").is_file()
    ]
    coverage = [
        (language, path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for language in LANGUAGES
        if (path := directory / f"coverage-{language}.xml").is_file()
    ]
    csv, markdown = render_tests(
        manifest, reports, coverage, parse_policy(_config(root)).limits
    )
    _publish(root, "tests.csv", csv)
    _publish(root, "tests.md", markdown)


def _clear_bench(root: Path, language: str) -> str:
    manifest = _manifest(root, True) or {"schema_version": 1}
    path = _directory(root, True) / "bench.csv"
    previous = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.is_file() else ""
    benchmarks = manifest.get("benchmarks", {})
    benchmarks = benchmarks if isinstance(benchmarks, dict) else {}
    benchmarks.pop(language, None)
    manifest["benchmarks"] = benchmarks
    _retract(root, "bench.csv", True)
    _retract(root, "bench.md", True)
    _publish(root, "latest.json", json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), True)
    return previous


def _publish_bench(
    root: Path, language: str, measured: Sequence[Row], previous: str
) -> None:
    rows = merge_bench(previous, language, measured)
    _publish(root, "bench.csv", bench_csv(rows), True)
    _publish(root, "bench.md", bench_markdown(rows), True)


def _fresh(path: Path) -> None:
    """Replace a native output directory, refusing symlinked ancestors."""
    for ancestor in (path, *path.parents):
        if ancestor.is_symlink() or (ancestor.exists() and not ancestor.is_dir()):
            raise EvidenceError(
                f"refusing non-directory or symlink report ancestor {ancestor}"
            )
    if path.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(path)
    path.mkdir(parents=True)


def _executable(name: str) -> str:
    """Resolve a native tool to a full path so Windows command shims also run."""
    resolved = shutil.which(name)
    if resolved is None:
        raise EvidenceError(f"{name} is not installed; install it through mise")
    return resolved


def _command(arguments: Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [_executable(arguments[0]), *arguments[1:]]


def _execute(
    arguments: Sequence[str], cwd: Path, environment: dict[str, str] | None = None
) -> bool:
    try:
        return (
            subprocess.run(
                _command(arguments), cwd=cwd, env=environment, check=False
            ).returncode
            == 0
        )
    except OSError as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"execute {arguments[0]}: {error}") from error


def _query(root: Path, arguments: Sequence[str]) -> str | None:
    """A short read-only command's standard output, or None when it is unavailable."""
    executable = shutil.which(arguments[0])
    if executable is None:
        return None
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [executable, *arguments[1:]],
            cwd=root,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
            check=False,
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None
    return result.stdout if result.returncode == 0 else None


def _tools(
    root: Path, policy: Policy, target: tuple[str, str], coverage: bool
) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """Native tool versions; unavailable tools are recorded as absent, never guessed."""
    category, language = target
    if language == "rust":
        commands = [
            ("cargo", ["cargo", "--version"]),
            ("cargo-nextest", ["cargo", "nextest", "--version"]),
        ]
    elif language == "python":
        commands = [("uv", ["uv", "--version"])]
    else:
        commands = [("node", ["node", "--version"])]
        runners = {
            item.selection.command[0]
            for item in selections(policy, category, language)
            if isinstance(item.selection, ScriptRunner)
        }
        commands += [(name, [name, "--version"]) for name in sorted(runners - {"node"})]
    if coverage:
        commands.append(("cargo-llvm-cov", ["cargo", "llvm-cov", "--version"]))
    versions = {}
    for name, arguments in commands:
        text = _query(root, arguments)
        versions[name] = text.splitlines()[0].strip() if text and text.strip() else None
    return versions


def _metadata(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            _command(["cargo", "metadata", "--no-deps", "--format-version", "1"]),
            cwd=root,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
    except OSError as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"test target inventory: {error}") from error
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise EvidenceError(f"test target inventory: {result.stderr.strip()}")
    try:
        return json.loads(result.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"test target inventory: {error}") from error


def _run_selections(
    root: Path,
    policy: Policy,
    raw: Path,
    selected: Sequence[Configuration],
    target: tuple[str, str],
    coverage: bool,
    records: list[Record],
) -> None:
    category, language = target
    if not selected:
        raise EvidenceError("no test configuration selects this category and language")
    failures = []
    for configuration in selected:
        output = raw / configuration.name
        record: Record = {"configuration": configuration.name}
        selection = configuration.selection

        def execute(
            output: Path = output,
            record: Record = record,
            selection: RustSelection | PythonSelection | ScriptRunner = selection,
        ) -> None:
            _fresh(output)
            if isinstance(selection, RustSelection):
                _rust(root, policy, output, selection, (category, coverage), record)
            elif isinstance(selection, PythonSelection):
                _python(root, policy, output, selection, (category, coverage), record)
            else:
                _script(root, policy, output, selection, category, record)

        failure = _attempt(execute)
        record["success"] = failure is None
        record["error"] = _message(failure)
        records.append(record)
        if failure is not None:
            failures.append(f"{configuration.name}: {failure}")
    if failures:
        raise EvidenceError("\n".join(failures))


def _rust(
    root: Path,
    policy: Policy,
    output: Path,
    selection: RustSelection,
    mode: tuple[str, bool],
    record: Record,
) -> None:
    category, coverage = mode
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    if coverage:
        target = root / "target/validation/cargo/coverage"
        environment["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"] = str(target)
        environment["CARGO_LLVM_COV_TARGET_DIR"] = str(target)
        environment["CARGO_LLVM_COV_BUILD_DIR"] = str(target)
    metadata = {} if category == "unit" else _metadata(root)
    selected = narrowed(rust_filter(metadata, category, selection), selection)
    native = output / "nextest.toml"
    native.write_text(
        nextest_config((output / "junit.xml").as_posix(), category, policy, coverage),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    started = time.monotonic()
    host_only = ["--coverage-host-only"] if selection.coverage_host_only else []
    runner = (
        ["cargo", "llvm-cov", "nextest", "--no-report", *host_only]
        if coverage
        else ["cargo", "nextest", "run"]
    )
    units = ["--lib", "--bins"] if category == "unit" else []
    runner += [
        *cargo_selection(selection),
        *units,
        "--config-file",
        str(native),
        "--profile",
        "stkr",
        "--no-tests",
        "fail",
        "-E",
        selected,
    ]
    listing = [
        "cargo",
        "nextest",
        "list",
        "--message-format",
        "json",
        *cargo_selection(selection),
        *units,
        "-E",
        selected,
    ]
    inventory_environment = dict(environment)
    if coverage:
        shown = subprocess.run(
            _command(["cargo", "llvm-cov", "show-env", "--cmd", *host_only]),
            cwd=root,
            env=environment,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
        if shown.returncode != 0:
            raise EvidenceError(f"coverage inventory setup failed: {shown.stderr}")
        inventory_environment.update(coverage_environment(shown.stdout))
    listed = subprocess.run(
        _command(listing),
        cwd=root,
        env=inventory_environment,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    (output / "inventory.json").write_bytes(listed.stdout)
    if listed.returncode != 0:
        raise EvidenceError(
            "compiled test inventory failed: " + listed.stderr.decode(errors="replace")
        )
    passed = _execute(runner, root, environment=environment)
    # Reporting is attempted even when the test command fails.
    report_errors = []
    if coverage:
        cobertura = output / "coverage.xml"
        exported = _attempt(
            lambda: _execute(
                [
                    "cargo",
                    "llvm-cov",
                    "report",
                    "--cobertura",
                    "--ignore-filename-regex",
                    "(/tests/|/benches/|/fixtures/)",
                    "--output-path",
                    str(cobertura),
                ],
                root,
                environment=environment,
            )
        )
        if exported is not True:
            report_errors.append(f"coverage export: {exported}")
        html = _attempt(
            lambda: _execute(
                [
                    "cargo",
                    "llvm-cov",
                    "report",
                    "--html",
                    "--output-dir",
                    str(output / "html"),
                    "--ignore-filename-regex",
                    "(/tests/|/benches/|/fixtures/)",
                ],
                root,
                environment=environment,
            )
        )
        if html is not True:
            report_errors.append(f"coverage HTML export: {html}")
        checked = _attempt(
            lambda: validate_coverage(_read(cobertura, "coverage report"))
        )
        if checked is not None:
            report_errors.append(str(checked))
    summary = _attempt(
        lambda: summarize(
            _read(output / "junit.xml", "JUnit report"), category, coverage
        )
    )
    # Documentation Tests Follow The Shared Policy In Full Integration Runs
    full = selection.filter is None and not selection.targets
    members = set(metadata.get("workspace_members", []))
    doc_packages = (
        [
            package["name"]
            for package in metadata.get("packages", [])
            if (not members or package.get("id") in members)
            and package["name"] not in selection.exclude
            and (not selection.packages or package["name"] in selection.packages)
            and _docs_version(package.get("version", ""), _config(root).get("docs", {}))
            and any(
                target.get("doctest", True) and "lib" in target.get("kind", [])
                for target in package.get("targets", [])
            )
        ]
        if category == "integration" and full
        else []
    )
    docs: object = True
    if doc_packages:
        arguments = ["--locked"]
        for package in doc_packages:
            arguments += ["--package", package]
        if selection.all_features:
            arguments.append("--all-features")
        if selection.no_default_features:
            arguments.append("--no-default-features")
        if selection.features:
            arguments += ["--features", ",".join(selection.features)]
        docs = _attempt(lambda: _execute(["cargo", "test", "--doc", *arguments], root))
    record["source_scope"] = (
        "workspace authored Rust sources; tests, benches, and fixtures excluded"
    )
    record["selection"] = asdict(selection)
    record["elapsed_seconds_including_build"] = time.monotonic() - started
    record["summary"] = None if isinstance(summary, EvidenceError) else summary
    record["junit_error"] = _message(summary)
    record["doctests_passed"] = docs is True if doc_packages else None
    record["doctests_run"] = bool(doc_packages)
    record["doctest_packages"] = doc_packages
    record["doctest_coverage"] = "not measured"
    record["report_errors"] = report_errors
    if not passed:
        raise EvidenceError("test runner failed; reports retained")
    if report_errors:
        raise EvidenceError("\n".join(report_errors))
    if isinstance(summary, EvidenceError):
        raise summary
    if summary["failed"]:
        raise EvidenceError("JUnit records failed tests")
    for test in summary["slow"]:
        print(
            f"slow test: {json.dumps(test)}; inspect setup, waits, and classification without "
            "reducing coverage",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
    if docs is not True:
        raise EvidenceError("doctests failed; reports retained")


def _python(
    root: Path,
    policy: Policy,
    output: Path,
    selection: PythonSelection,
    mode: tuple[str, bool],
    record: Record,
) -> None:
    category, coverage = mode
    record["selection"] = asdict(selection)
    factor = COVERAGE_FACTOR if coverage else 1
    timeout = timeout_seconds(policy, category) * factor
    project = root / selection.project
    try:
        manifest = tomllib.loads(_read(project / "pyproject.toml", "Python project"))
    except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"invalid pyproject.toml: {error}") from error
    native = manifest.get("build-system", {}).get("build-backend") == "maturin"
    preinstalled = selection.install == "preinstalled"
    # A preinstalled wheel was built elsewhere, so its native code cannot be instrumented.
    instrument = coverage and native and not preinstalled
    profile = (
        selection.native_profile
        or manifest.get("tool", {}).get("maturin", {}).get("profile")
        or "release"
    )
    suite = project / "tests" / category
    if not suite.is_dir():
        raise EvidenceError(f"missing Python suite {suite}")
    cobertura = output / "coverage.xml"
    native_cobertura = output / "native-coverage.xml"
    started = time.monotonic()
    scratch = output / "runtime"
    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if preinstalled:
        command = ["uv", "run", "--no-sync"]
    else:
        command = ["uv", "run", "--locked", "--group", "test"]
        if native:
            command += ["--config-setting", f"build-args=--profile {profile}"]
        if category == "acceptance":
            command.append("--no-editable")
    command += [
        "python",
        "-m",
        "pytest",
        "--strict-config",
        "--strict-markers",
        "--import-mode=importlib",
        "--timeout-method=thread",
        f"--timeout={timeout}",
        f"--junitxml={output / 'junit.xml'}",
    ]
    if selection.filter is not None:
        command += ["-k", selection.filter]
    command.append(str(suite))
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    # An ambient pytest selection must not silently narrow a required suite.
    environment.pop("PYTEST_ADDOPTS", None)
    environment.pop("COVERAGE_PROCESS_START", None)
    environment["UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT"] = str(root / ".venv")
    if coverage:
        sources = (
            _python_packages(project, selection.sources)
            if category == "acceptance" or preinstalled
            else list(selection.sources)
        )
        command += [f"--cov={source}" for source in sources]
        command.append(f"--cov-report=xml:{cobertura}")
        environment["COVERAGE_FILE"] = str(output / ".coverage")
    native_target = scratch / "native-target"
    native_environment: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    rust_policy = policy.rust[0].selection
    host_only = (
        ["--coverage-host-only"]
        if isinstance(rust_policy, RustSelection) and rust_policy.coverage_host_only
        else []
    )
    if instrument:
        setup = dict(os.environ, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(native_target))
        setup.pop("RUSTC_WRAPPER", None)
        shown = subprocess.run(
            _command(["cargo", "llvm-cov", "show-env", "--cmd", *host_only]),
            cwd=project,
            env=setup,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
        if shown.returncode != 0:
            raise EvidenceError(f"native coverage setup failed: {shown.stderr}")
        native_environment = coverage_environment(shown.stdout)
        environment.update(native_environment)
        environment["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"] = str(native_target)
        environment["UV_CACHE_DIR"] = str(scratch / "uv-cache")
    record["install"] = selection.install
    record["installed_distribution"] = (
        _installed(project, manifest, environment) if preinstalled else None
    )
    passed = _execute(command, project, environment)
    summary = _attempt(
        lambda: summarize(
            _read(output / "junit.xml", "JUnit report"), category, coverage
        )
    )
    errors = []
    if coverage:
        normalized = _attempt(
            lambda: _normalize(root, project, selection.sources, cobertura)
        )
        if normalized is not None:
            errors.append(str(normalized))
        checked = _attempt(
            lambda: validate_coverage(_read(cobertura, "coverage report"))
        )
        if checked is not None:
            errors.append(str(checked))
    if instrument:
        exported = _attempt(
            lambda: _execute(
                [
                    "cargo",
                    "llvm-cov",
                    "report",
                    "--cobertura",
                    "--profile",
                    profile,
                    "--output-path",
                    str(native_cobertura),
                ],
                project,
                dict(
                    os.environ,
                    **dict(native_environment),
                    CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(native_target),
                ),
            )
        )
        if exported is not True:
            errors.append(f"native coverage export: {exported}")
        checked = _attempt(
            lambda: validate_coverage(_read(native_cobertura, "coverage report"))
        )
        if checked is not None:
            errors.append(str(checked))
    record["source_scope"] = list(selection.sources)
    record["native_instrumented"] = instrument
    record["native_profile"] = profile if native and not preinstalled else None
    record["elapsed_seconds_including_build"] = time.monotonic() - started
    record["summary"] = None if isinstance(summary, EvidenceError) else summary
    record["junit_error"] = _message(summary)
    record["report_errors"] = errors
    if not passed:
        raise EvidenceError("pytest failed; reports retained")
    if errors:
        raise EvidenceError("\n".join(errors))
    if isinstance(summary, EvidenceError):
        raise summary
    if summary["failed"]:
        raise EvidenceError("JUnit records failed tests")


def _read(path: Path, description: str) -> str:
    try:
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError as error:
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"read required {description} {path}: {error.strerror}"
        ) from error


def _installed(
    project: Path, manifest: dict[str, Any], environment: dict[str, str]
) -> Record:
    """The project distribution an earlier step installed; editable installs are refused."""
    name = manifest.get("project", {}).get("name")
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
        raise EvidenceError("a preinstalled Python project needs [project] name")
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            _command(["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "python", "-c", INSTALLED_PROBE, name]),
            cwd=project,
            env=environment,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * 6,
            check=False,
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"inspect installed {name}: {error}") from error
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"{name} is not installed in the shared environment; run the step that "
            "installs the wheel first"
        )
    try:
        version, origin = json.loads(result.stdout)
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"inspect installed {name}: {error}") from error
    if isinstance(origin, dict) and origin.get("dir_info", {}).get("editable"):
        raise EvidenceError(f"{name} is installed editable, not as a built wheel")
    url = origin.get("url") if isinstance(origin, dict) else None
    return {"name": name, "version": version, "url": url}


def _script(
    root: Path,
    policy: Policy,
    output: Path,
    runner: ScriptRunner,
    category: str,
    record: Record,
) -> None:
    """Run a script test command whose JUnit lands in the module-owned output."""
    deadline = timeout_seconds(policy, category)
    junit = output / "junit.xml"
    command = [
        argument.replace(JUNIT_PLACEHOLDER, str(junit)).replace(
            TIMEOUT_PLACEHOLDER, str(deadline * 1000)
        )
        for argument in runner.command
    ]
    started = time.monotonic()
    record["selection"] = asdict(runner)
    passed = _execute_bounded(command, root / runner.directory, runner.timeout_seconds)
    record["elapsed_seconds_including_build"] = time.monotonic() - started
    summary = _attempt(lambda: summarize(_read(junit, "JUnit report"), category, False))
    record["summary"] = None if isinstance(summary, EvidenceError) else summary
    record["junit_error"] = _message(summary)
    overrun = _attempt(lambda: _overruns(_read(junit, "JUnit report"), deadline))
    record["deadline_overruns"] = overrun if isinstance(overrun, list) else []
    record["coverage"] = "not measured"
    if passed is None:
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"runner exceeded {runner.timeout_seconds} s and was stopped; reports retained"
        )
    if not passed:
        raise EvidenceError("test runner failed; reports retained")
    if isinstance(summary, EvidenceError):
        raise summary
    if summary["failed"]:
        raise EvidenceError("JUnit records failed tests")
    if record["deadline_overruns"]:
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"tests exceeded the {deadline} s per-test deadline: "
            + ", ".join(record["deadline_overruns"])
        )


def _overruns(text: str, deadline: int) -> list[str]:
    """Cases whose recorded duration exceeds the per-test deadline."""
    names = []
    for case in _testcases(_parse(text)):
        try:
            seconds = float(case.get("time", "0"))
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if seconds > deadline:
            names.append(case.get("name", ""))
    return names


def _execute_bounded(
    arguments: Sequence[str], cwd: Path, timeout: int | None
) -> bool | None:
    """Run a command in its own process group; None when the bound stopped it."""
    try:
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                _command(arguments),
                cwd=cwd,
                creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP,
            )
        else:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                _command(arguments), cwd=cwd, start_new_session=True
            )
    except OSError as error:
        raise EvidenceError(f"execute {arguments[0]}: {error}") from error
    try:
        return process.wait(timeout=timeout) == 0
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        # Package-manager shims leave the runner as a child; stop the whole group.
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            subprocess.run(
                ["taskkill", "/F", "/T", "/PID", str(process.pid)],
                capture_output=True,
                check=False,
            )
        else:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        process.wait()
        return None


def _python_packages(project: Path, sources: Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Importable packages below the declared roots, for installed acceptance coverage."""
    packages: set[str] = set()
    for source in sources:
        path = project / source
        if (path / "__init__.py").is_file():
            packages.add(path.name)
            continue
        for entry in path.iterdir():
            if entry.is_dir() and entry.name != "__pycache__":
                packages.add(entry.name)
            elif entry.suffix == ".py":
                packages.add(entry.stem)
    if not packages:
        raise EvidenceError("no Python packages found under declared coverage sources")
    return sorted(packages)


def _normalize(root: Path, project: Path, sources: Sequence[str], path: Path) -> None:
    """Normalize installed-wheel filenames back to declared authored source paths."""
    authored = []
    for source in sources:
        for file in sorted((project / source).rglob("*.py")):
            if not file.is_file():
                continue
            relative = file.relative_to(project).as_posix()
            suffix = relative
            for prefix in ("src/", "python/"):
                if relative.startswith(prefix):
                    suffix = relative.removeprefix(prefix)
                    break
            authored.append((suffix, file.relative_to(root).as_posix()))
    text = normalize_python_paths(
        _read(path, "Python coverage paths"), root.as_posix(), authored
    )
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def _bench_rust(root: Path, log: Path) -> list[Row]:
    metadata = _metadata(root)
    home = os.environ.get("CRITERION_HOME")
    output = Path(home) if home else Path(metadata["target_directory"]) / "criterion"
    members = set(metadata.get("workspace_members", []))
    rows = []
    for package in metadata.get("packages", []):
        if members and package.get("id") not in members:
            continue
        for target in package.get("targets", []):
            if "bench" not in target.get("kind", []):
                continue
            since = time.time()
            _tee(
                [
                    "cargo",
                    "bench",
                    "--locked",
                    "--package",
                    package["name"],
                    "--bench",
                    target["name"],
                ],
                root,
                log,
                f"Rust {target['name']}",
            )
            rows.extend(_criterion(output, target["name"], since))
    if not rows:
        raise EvidenceError("no Criterion results were produced")
    return rows


def _bench_python(root: Path, policy: Policy, log: Path) -> list[Row]:
    selection = policy.python[0].selection
    project = root / (
        selection.project if isinstance(selection, PythonSelection) else "."
    )
    if not (project / "benchmarks").is_dir():
        raise EvidenceError(f"missing Python benchmarks {project / 'benchmarks'}")
    raw = root / "target" / "validation" / "bench"
    raw.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report = raw / "python.json"
    report.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    environment = dict(os.environ, UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=str(root / ".venv"))
    environment.pop("PYTEST_ADDOPTS", None)
    _tee(
        [
            "uv",
            "run",
            "--locked",
            "--group",
            "test",
            "python",
            "-m",
            "pytest",
            "--strict-config",
            "--strict-markers",
            "--import-mode=importlib",
            "--benchmark-only",
            "--benchmark-save-data",
            f"--benchmark-json={report}",
            "benchmarks",
        ],
        project,
        log,
        "Python",
        environment,
    )
    return pytest_benchmark(_read(report, "benchmark results"))


def _tee(
    arguments: Sequence[str],
    cwd: Path,
    log: Path,
    section: str,
    environment: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Run a command, mirroring its output to the terminal and a titled log section."""
    command = _command(arguments)
    with log.open("ab") as file:
        file.write(f"== {section} ==\n$ {' '.join(arguments)}\n".encode())
        file.flush()
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            command,
            cwd=cwd,
            env=environment,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        )
        guard = threading.Lock()

        def copy(source: IO[bytes], terminal: IO[bytes]) -> None:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: os.read(source.fileno(), 8192), b""):
                terminal.write(chunk)
                terminal.flush()
                with guard:
                    file.write(chunk)

        threads = [
            threading.Thread(target=copy, args=(process.stdout, sys.stdout.buffer)),
            threading.Thread(target=copy, args=(process.stderr, sys.stderr.buffer)),
        ]
        for thread in threads:
            thread.start()
        status = process.wait()
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join()
    if status != 0:
        raise EvidenceError(
            f"benchmark section {section} failed with {status}; see {log}"
        )


def _criterion(output: Path, domain: str, since: float) -> list[Row]:
    """Read the Criterion results written for one bench target since it started."""
    rows = []
    if output.is_dir():
        for path in output.rglob("benchmark.json"):
            if path.parent.name != "new" or path.stat().st_mtime < since:
                continue

            def load(name: str, directory: Path = path.parent) -> Record:
                try:
                    return json.loads(_read(directory / name, "Criterion result"))
                except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
                    raise EvidenceError(f"invalid Criterion {name}: {error}") from error

            rows.append(
                criterion_row(
                    domain,
                    load("benchmark.json"),
                    load("estimates.json"),
                    load("sample.json"),
                )
            )
    rows.sort(key=lambda row: row.name)
    return rows


# === Entry Point === #

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Capture And Validate Flat Screenshots With Revision Metadata"""

# === Imports === #

# Standard Library Imports
import json
import re
import struct
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

# Third Party Imports

# Local Imports
from . import _policy, evidence

# Type Checking Imports

# === Public Exports === #

# === Constants === #

PNG = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024

# === Types === #

# === Classes === #

# === Public Functions === #


def dimensions(data: bytes) -> tuple[int, int]:
    if len(data) < 33 or data[:8] != PNG or data[12:16] != b"IHDR":
        raise _policy.ToolError("screenshot must contain a PNG IHDR")
    return struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24])


def check(directory: Path, _: str = "check") -> None:
    settings = _policy.policy(directory, "screenshots")
    folder = _policy.inside(directory, "screenshots")
    if not folder.is_dir():
        raise _policy.ToolError("screenshots/ is missing")
    readme = (folder / "README.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    manifest = json.loads((folder / "manifest.json").read_text())
    if not isinstance(manifest, list):
        raise _policy.ToolError("screenshot manifest must be an array")
    entries = {}
    for entry in manifest:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not all(
            key in entry
            for key in [
                "image",
                "surface",
                "state",
                "viewport",
                "revision",
                "captured_at",
            ]
        ):
            raise _policy.ToolError("screenshot manifest entry is incomplete")
        image = entry["image"]
        if image in entries or image != f"{entry['surface']}-{entry['state']}.png":
            raise _policy.ToolError(f"duplicate or inconsistent screenshot: {image}")
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)+\.png", image):
            raise _policy.ToolError(f"invalid screenshot name: {image}")
        entries[image] = entry
    images = set()
    for path in folder.iterdir():
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
            raise _policy.ToolError(
                f"screenshots must be flat regular files: {path.name}"
            )
        if path.name in ["README.md", "manifest.json"]:
            continue
        if path.suffix != ".png" or path.stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES:
            raise _policy.ToolError(
                f"screenshot must be PNG at most 4 MiB: {path.name}"
            )
        images.add(path.name)
        if path.name not in entries or not re.search(
            r"\]\((?:\./)?" + re.escape(path.name) + r"\)", readme
        ):
            raise _policy.ToolError(
                f"screenshot missing manifest or README reference: {path.name}"
            )
        entry = entries[path.name]
        width, height = dimensions(path.read_bytes())
        if entry["viewport"] != {"width": width, "height": height}:
            raise _policy.ToolError(f"screenshot viewport mismatch: {path.name}")
        timestamp = datetime.fromisoformat(entry["captured_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        if timestamp.tzinfo is None:
            raise _policy.ToolError("captured_at requires a timezone")
        revision = entry["revision"]
        if not isinstance(revision, str) or not re.fullmatch(
            r"[0-9a-f]{40,64}", revision
        ):
            raise _policy.ToolError("revision requires a full commit hash")
        branch = settings.get("integration_branch", "main")
        if (
            not isinstance(branch, str)
            or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9/._-]+", branch) is None
        ):
            raise _policy.ToolError("invalid integration branch name")
        _policy.execute(
            directory,
            ["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", revision, branch],
            capture=True,
        )
        behind = int(
            _policy.execute(
                directory,
                ["git", "rev-list", "--count", f"{revision}..{branch}"],
                capture=True,
            )
        )
        limit = settings.get("max_commits_behind", 0)
        if not isinstance(limit, int) or limit < 0 or behind > limit:
            raise _policy.ToolError(
                f"screenshot revision is {behind} commits behind {branch}: {path.name}"
            )
    if images != set(entries):
        raise _policy.ToolError("screenshot manifest contains missing images")


def capture(directory: Path, _: str = "capture") -> None:
    settings = _policy.policy(directory, "screenshots")
    scenes = settings.get("scenes", [])
    if not isinstance(scenes, list) or not scenes:
        raise _policy.ToolError("screenshots.scenes must declare capture commands")
    folder = _policy.inside(directory, "screenshots")
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    revision = evidence.revision(directory)
    if revision is None:
        raise _policy.ToolError("cannot determine screenshot revision")
    entries = []
    for scene in scenes:
        surface, state = scene["surface"], scene["state"]
        image = f"{surface}-{state}.png"
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)+\.png", image):
            raise _policy.ToolError(f"invalid scene name: {image}")
        target = _policy.inside(folder, image)
        target.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        arguments = _policy.command(scene.get("command"), "screenshots.scenes.command")
        _policy.execute(
            directory, [part.replace("{output}", str(target)) for part in arguments]
        )
        width, height = dimensions(target.read_bytes())
        entries.append(
            {
                "image": image,
                "surface": surface,
                "state": state,
                "viewport": {"width": width, "height": height},
                "revision": revision,
                "captured_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            }
        )
    _policy.write_json(folder / "manifest.json", entries)
    check(directory)


def run(directory: Path, verb: str) -> None:
    if verb == "capture":
        capture(directory)
    else:
        check(directory)


# === Private Functions === #

# === Entry Point === #

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(_policy.main("screenshots", ["capture", "check"], run))

"""Check And Synchronize Declared Static Package Versions"""

# === Imports === #

# Standard Library Imports
import json
import re
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

# Third Party Imports

# Local Imports
from . import _policy

# Type Checking Imports

# === Public Exports === #

# === Constants === #

VERSION = r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(?:\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?"

# === Types === #

# === Classes === #

# === Public Functions === #


def versions(text: str, name: str) -> list[str]:
    if name.endswith("package.json"):
        value = json.loads(text).get("version")
        return [value] if isinstance(value, str) else []
    if name.endswith(".toml"):
        value = tomllib.loads(text)
        tables = [
            value.get("package", {}),
            value.get("project", {}),
            value.get("workspace", {}).get("package", {}),
        ]
        return [
            table["version"]
            for table in tables
            if isinstance(table.get("version"), str)
        ]
    found = re.search(r"^## \[?v?(" + VERSION + r")\]?", text, re.MULTILINE)
    return [found.group(1)] if found else []


def run(directory: Path, verb: str) -> None:
    settings = _policy.policy(directory, "version")
    target = settings.get("value")
    if not isinstance(target, str) or re.fullmatch(VERSION, target) is None:
        raise _policy.ToolError("version.value must declare a semantic version")
    paths = settings.get("files", ["Cargo.toml"])
    pending = []
    for name in paths:
        path = _policy.inside(directory, name)
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        current = versions(text, name)
        if not current:
            raise _policy.ToolError(f"no static version found: {name}")
        if verb == "check" and any(value != target for value in current):
            raise _policy.ToolError(f"{name}: versions {current} differ from {target}")
        if verb == "sync":
            if name.endswith("package.json"):
                document = json.loads(text)
                document["version"] = target
                text = json.dumps(document, indent=2) + "\n"
            elif name.endswith(".toml"):
                sections = re.split(r"(?m)(^\[.+?\]\s*$)", text)
                for index in range(1, len(sections), 2):
                    if sections[index].strip() in [
                        "[package]",
                        "[project]",
                        "[workspace.package]",
                    ]:
                        sections[index + 1] = re.sub(
                            r'(?m)^(version\s*=\s*)["\'][^"\']+["\']',
                            lambda match: match.group(1) + json.dumps(target),
                            sections[index + 1],
                        )
                text = "".join(sections)
            else:
                text = re.sub(
                    r"(?m)^(## \[?v?)" + VERSION,
                    lambda match: match.group(1) + target,
                    text,
                    count=1,
                )
            if versions(text, name) != [target] * len(current):
                raise _policy.ToolError(f"could not synchronize version: {name}")
            pending.append((path, text))
    for path, text in pending:
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


# === Private Functions === #

# === Entry Point === #

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(_policy.main("version", ["check", "sync"], run))
